experiment: E99 Amendment 1: R-net clause (ii) on cased rows only, as the plan words it; then stage 3 (forced-part and forbidden-part lowercase)
filed: 2026-11-05, filed before the Amendment 1 run, by the E99 Amendment 1 code writer; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)
plan: reports/plans/2026-11-05_plan_e99-refine-verify-definition.md (Refinements adopted, R-net; Stages). Base filing results/predictions.json (settings, thresholds, P3, P4) stands unchanged; S0-ii stays recorded as a miss (results/stage0.json, clause_ii.passes false).

why.plan_wording: R-net clause (ii), confirmed by the user: "the part's function in the original model depends on the input, on inputs the task never trained on (the cased-minus-lowercase gap with the part off, on cased rows)"
why.the_miss: S0-ii (rules.clause_ii) also required the move on lowercased rows, which the plan does not ask. Job 52787 read: cased rows move_gap -1.845 against band 0.758 (moves); lowercased rows (e53_lowercase) move_gap 0.703 against band 1.161 (does not move). The added lowercased-row requirement is the mis-specification; Amendment 1 drops it and keeps everything else.

predictions.stage: amend1 gate (no model; read from results/stage0.json)
predictions.rule: rules.moves(stage0.json clause_ii.cased.move_gap, stage0.json clause_ii.cased.band): strictly |move| > band, both finite. The band is rules.band of the same 20 random head pairs' moves on the same cased rows (95th percentile of |move|).
predictions.expected_from: |-1.845| = 1.845 > 0.758: passes (computed from stage0.json's stored numbers before filing)
predictions.beside_not_in_rule: the lowercased-row reading (move_gap 0.703, band 1.161, does not move) is printed beside, not part of the rule
predictions.on_miss: stage 3 is not run: lowercase stays 'does not apply'

predictions.expected: net 1 on both seeds, matched or cap
predictions.on_miss: off 1 on a state with gain: stop; cap: R-net falls back to 'does not apply'

predictions.expected: within band and 'as fast' on both seeds
predictions.on_miss: reported; slower by more than 2x reads 'the part matters for learning, not for the increment'

clause_ii_cased.what: W0's lowercase-minus-capitalised log-odds gap moved by setting the lowercase pair (1,1)+(1,2) to W0's means, on cased val rows (inputs the lowercase task never trained on), against the random-pair band on the same rows
clause_ii_cased.blind_to: an input dependence the cased-row gap does not show (a part whose function changes with the input in a way that leaves this one gap unmoved reads 'does not move'); and a removal that moves any gap at all: random head pairs move the cased gap too (all 20 draws are negative, -0.005 to -1.228), so the rule compares |move| with the band of |random moves| and says only that the pair moves the gap more than 19 of 20 random pairs, not that it moves it in a specific direction
clause_ii_cased.positive_control: the base filing's: on lowercased rows E97 read 0.70 (gap unit); in job 52787 the cased-row reading is the scored one and the lowercased-row reading is printed beside
clause_ii_cased.noise_floor: the random-pair band of W0's move on the same cased rows, 0.758 in job 52787 (stored, not re-measured)

edge_cases.zero_band: rules.moves(-1.845, 0.0) -> True, rules.moves(0.0, 0.0) -> False: a zero band (all 20 random moves exactly 0) would let any nonzero move pass; not the case here (band 0.758), and amend1.py refuses to start unless stage0.json's stored move and band equal the filed inputs above
edge_cases.do_nothing: a removal of nothing moves the gap by 0 (G = 0 has no meaning here: the clause reads W0 only): rules.moves(0.0, 0.758) -> False, so the do-nothing cannot pass
edge_cases.sign: rules.moves(+1.845, 0.758) and rules.moves(-1.845, 0.758) -> True both: the band is on |move|

outputs: results/stage3_amend1.json (as run.py's stage 3: forced lowercase s0, s1 then forbidden lowercase s0, s1, plus the amended clause record); results/run.out appended
